_about: Trade Partner Rebate Program terms (Andrew 11/27). The one source for the flyer on the Trade Partners page in Agility and for the registration page at /trade-partner. Change a number or a sentence here and both follow. See docs/sales/trade-partners.md.
name: Trade Partner Rebate Program

payment.label: Check or ACH
payment.detail: On invoices paid by check or ACH within terms

terms: Program year January 1 – December 31, 2027, for approved trade partners. Only appliance invoices billed to the trade partner's account qualify; cabinetry and HVAC are invoiced separately and are not part of this program. An invoice counts once it is paid in full and posted by December 31, 2027.

Tier is based on annual net qualifying purchases after returns and credits. Delivery, installation, freight, tax, accessories, service plans and clearance or display units do not qualify. Sub-Zero, Wolf and Cove are excluded. Brand eligibility is subject to each manufacturer's discretion.

Check/ACH bonus requires invoices paid in full within terms; card payments do not earn it. Account must be in good standing at payout. Rebates are issued in March 2028. Wilson AC & Appliance may modify or end this program at any time.
